SK_Luminara_Loading.name: Luminara Verge loading ring
SK_Luminara_Loading.text: Agricultural orbital loading ring above the Luminara Fields: green-lit greenhouse cylinders beyond viewports, freight rails, seed vault containers, grain pallets wrapped in dull moisture barrier, patched Verge cargo tugs and practical working crews. Bright plant green is functional rather than decorative; nothing feels luxurious.

SK_CargoDeck.name: Slip Knife cargo deck
SK_CargoDeck.text: Low-ceilinged blockade-runner cargo bay packed around the ship's structure rather than designed for comfort: scarred deck plates, mismatched restraint rails, old patch welds, narrow catwalks and cargo lashed tightly into every legal and barely legal volume. No clean naval symmetry.

SK_Bridge.name: Slip Knife bridge
SK_Bridge.text: Cramped forward control room built around two pilot-navigation stations and a captain's standing rail. Repaired displays, physical toggles, route scratches, removable access panels and mismatched seats reveal generations of modification. Visibility is through instruments and narrow armored ports rather than a panoramic command deck.

SK_EngineBay.name: Slip Knife engine bay
SK_EngineBay.text: Tight hot machinery spaces around an overworked runner drive: exposed service trunks, patched insulation, removable armor access, coolant lines, vibration braces, scorched fasteners and hand tools clipped everywhere. The machinery should feel maintained aggressively, not neglected.

SK_Auric_Gate.name: Auric Gate debris corridor
SK_Auric_Gate.text: Fortress chokepoint cut through asteroid rock and surrounded by old siege wreckage, half-melted turrets, broken hull plates and mineral-gold dust. Defensive structures and debris create overlapping sensor shadows and dangerous narrow seams. Red hostile markings are sparse; the dominant visual impression is dark wreckage in golden haze.

SK_Auric_Freeport.name: Auric Freeport outer docks
SK_Auric_Freeport.text: Crowded Verge receiving docks welded from old hulls and newer pressure modules: cargo gantries, grain bins, market runners, patched haulers, family freight crews, green route lamps and violet market cloth. Every surface shows use. Supplies move immediately from ship to storage; nothing arriving here is ornamental.

SK_Ember_Cantina.name: Ember Cantina
SK_Ember_Cantina.text: Loud low-ceilinged Verge music hall at the edge of the Auric Bazaar: hammered-string instruments, scrap drums, scarred tables, engine-metal wall panels, steam and spice from communal food, runner crews shoulder-to-shoulder with dock workers. Performance is communal and rough, not polished stage entertainment.
